text: Astronomy, the study of the universe, is an exciting field that delves into the vastness of space and the myriad of celestial phenomena that occur. One of the fundamental concepts in astronomy is orbit, the continuous path that celestial bodies follow around a central mass. As planets and moons revolve around the sun, they complete full orbits, a fundamental principle that explains their motion and appearances. Craters, the impact sites left by asteroids and comets, are another hallmark of celestial bodies. Over time, these craters grow deeper as impacts create new surfaces, altering their initial appearances. Through observation and analysis, astronomers gain insights into the formation and evolution of worlds beyond our own, expanding our understanding of the cosmos.
